notes: The NTU $110 million gift and the $120 million UOB90 pledge (250,000 beneficiaries over five years) are commitments mostly for future years, recorded as context and not driving the score. The Ruangguru five-year 90,000-child programme in Indonesia is an extension of UOB My Digital Space (E5) and is not listed separately to avoid double counting. UOB FinLab ('partners companies on their digitalisation journeys') could support Entrepreneurship, but its only sentence exceeds the quote length limit and gives no figures, so it is not recorded. Aggregate figures ($32.1 million community contributions, more than 350,000 beneficiaries, more than 1,500 artists impacted) overlap the listed programs and are not counted separately. The coal policy states an exit from thermal coal financing by 2039; this is loan-book exposure, not a red flag. The Board Diversity Policy and the equal-opportunity code of conduct are policy language (level 1 at most).
